description_en: Queries the IP addresses that are blocked by a defense rule against brute-force attacks
description_zh: 查询防暴力破解拦截IP的记录，即用户配置的防暴力破解策略拦截成功的拦截记录
name: DescribeBruteForceRecords

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The status of the defense rule. Valid values:

0: invalid
1: enabled
2: failed
parameters.help_zh:
暴力破解防御规则的状态。
取值：
0：失效
1：启用
2： 失败
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The IP address that is blocked
parameters.name: block_ip

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned on each page. We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的服务器实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name or IP address of the server to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的服务器的名称或IP地址
parameters.name: remark
